messages:
olivia: Quick proposal for v2 compatibility + rollout strategy. Short version: support dual routes for a transition window, provide SDK adapters + migration guide, opt-in canary header, clear launch criteria, and a 12-month sunset plan. Asking product + eng for scope tradeoffs.

olivia: Key goals: avoid surprise breakage for existing users, keep rollout low-op for infra, and give power users a fast migration path (SDK + examples).

drew: Thanks. Two immediate Qs: 1) function/tool-calling semantics change? 2) structured output validations (schema enforcement) — will v2 be stricter?

olivia: Good calls. Function-calling: we plan to keep same invocation model but rename some fields in v2 for clarity (e.g., "tools" -> "functions"). We'll provide a server-side shim to map v1 keys to v2 and warning headers when mismatches occur. Structured output: v2 will validate against optional JSON Schema if provided; default behavior is permissive but emits warnings.

neel: Migration checklist I'm thinking of (short):
- SDK adapters (node/py/rs) that expose aCompat() shim
- Opt-in header: `X-Redwood-API: v2` for canary testing
- Transformation shim in hosted plane: translate v1 payload -> v2 payload when compat mode on
- Regression tests: run existing eval suites against v2 and flag token-level diffs
- Telemetry: record `compat_mode`, `migration_step`, and `schema_rejection_rate`

neel: Example mapping: 
```
v1 route: POST /v1/generate
payload v1: {"model":"redwood-1","prompt":"..."}

v2 route: POST /v2/chat.completions
payload v2: {"model":"redwood-1","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"..."}]}
```
Shim behavior: if header `X-Redwood-API: v2` present and client hits /v1/*, we accept and translate automatically for canary users.

olivia: Launch criteria (must-haves before GA):
- Latency parity: 95th latency change <= +10ms vs v1 under standard load profile
- Unit/regression: zero critical failures on canonical eval suite (compare outputs within acceptable deltas)
- SDKs published with adapter, and migration examples for function calling and embeddings
- At least 3 pilot customers onboarded (different workloads: chat app, embeddings indexer, reranker)
- Docs: migration guide + automated code samples + FAQ

drew: Rollout timeline suggestion:
- Week 0: internal canary (opt-in header) + SDK alpha
- Weeks 1-4: external beta with 3 pilots, gather diffs + fix regressions
- Weeks 5-8: gradual public rollout (10% -> 50% -> 100%) with monitoring and automated rollbacks
- Month 6: mark v1 as "deprecated" (announce public deprecation calendar)
- Month 12: v1 sunset (turn off non-critical infra), security fixes only in months 6-12

neel: On deprecation comms: announce at GA with exact dates, email + console banners + per-tenant notices if they use deprecated features. Provide a compatibility report in console showing which routes/features they use that are incompatible.

olivia: Scope negotiation: we can ship a shim that covers the most common v1 patterns, but some advanced v1 behaviors (custom prompt templating, undocumented header behaviors) will be out-of-scope for M1. We should list unsupported patterns in the migration guide and offer migration help for enterprise customers.

neel: Metrics to watch during rollout: 5xx rate by route, token-per-request delta, avg latency P50/P95, schema_rejection_rate, and customer-facing error volume. Also track migration adoption percentage by tenant.

olivia: Developer experience notes: add a CLI command `rw migrate-check` that runs a quick compatibility scan against a tenant's eval set and returns a short report (pass/warn/fail). Publish code snippets for common cases: completions->chat, embeddings param rename, rerank route mapping.

olivia: Security & compliance: v1 and v2 both land in same control plane. For Private deployments we will provide a toggle in the customer config to disable automatic shimming (force strict v2).

neel: Customer asks: some customers want a longer runway (18-24 months). We can be flexible for enterprise contracts; default public timeline stays at 12 months but include contract exceptions.

olivia: Next steps: product will publish a one-pager + migration guide draft by EOW. Eng: prototype shim + SDK adapter alpha in 2 weeks. Ops: prepare canary infra and dashboards.

sre-bot: deploy scheduled: canary-shim v0.1 -> staging at 1760128000 (ETA). :rocket:

olivia: Thanks — please add any missing risks or blockers. If no objections I'll lock in these timelines tomorrow.
